title: FutureSim: Replaying World Events to Evaluate Adaptive Agents

claim.summary: FutureSim evaluates adaptive event forecasters in a dated-news replay environment where predictions can be revised and resolved outcomes become feedback.

modules.name: Chronological event-forecast revision environment
modules.scope_reason: The state advances by day, exposes only available documents, accepts event-outcome probability distributions, and reveals resolved answers for later adaptation.
